about: Waymark's routine contract and catalog of testigos (docs/adr/0006, 0012): the single source of what each task must do. A testigo answers its `claim` by executing (tool calls, git, a re-run), never by reading the agent's prose, and returns ✔ / ✘ / not applicable with its evidence; `enforce: block` stops the turn once when it fails, `record` only scores it. stop-hook.mjs judges them (the ones that need a process or git live in scripts/testigos.mjs, which also re-runs them by hand); the instructions block quotes every block claim; tests/hooks.test.mjs fails if they drift. Change a testigo here, nowhere else. Decision = the user's answer in the choice window, recorded as is; a question after the first change is recorded with its position and does not count against it (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2q). Gate = the exit of the agent's last gate after its last code change, else the repo typecheck re-run by the hook (40 s; never the full build); a failing gate blocks once (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2q). The memory line is written by the end-of-turn hook from the Cierre's Aprendido and the one index is the git notes (docs/adr/0012, 3e-2): neither is a testigo. Every testigo that applies blocks once, except the commit trailer (fixing it rewrites a commit, 2026-10-03 · T2j) and the chain (Waymark's own file). No browser testigo: browser verification runs only when the user asks (2026-10-03 · T2l).

testigos.label: Decision
testigos.claim: the user answered in the choice window before the task's first change

testigos.label: Verificar
testigos.claim: a gate after the last code change passes (yours, or the repo typecheck the hook re-runs)

testigos.label: Secretos
testigos.claim: no secret in the project memory, mem_save or the task's diff and commits

testigos.label: Recordar
testigos.claim: L2+: mem_search before the first change

testigos.label: Review
testigos.claim: L2+ with code: code-review on the task's files

testigos.label: Build
testigos.claim: L2+ with code: the build once at the end (not when memory.md's Quality gates has `build | none (<why>)`)

testigos.label: Docs
testigos.claim: an inference from docs backed by consulting them

testigos.label: Enrutar
testigos.claim: the owner's procedures.md section read before the first change

testigos.label: Tests
testigos.claim: a spec next to the changed code added or changed

testigos.label: Tests
testigos.claim: a red claim (rojo, habría fallado) backed by a test run before the first code change or in a clean worktree, or marked inferida

testigos.label: Previos
testigos.claim: a pre-existing failure checked in a clean copy

testigos.label: Commit
testigos.claim: the task's commits carry Waymark-Task: <task ID>

testigos.label: Cadena
testigos.claim: the provenance chain intact before this record
